title: Irregular sensor readings
fictional: All data is fictional (Example Ranch). Every threshold is a demonstration setting.
purpose: A 72-hour gap (T1), a conflicting duplicate (T3), an exact duplicate (T5), out-of-order rows (T7), a reading dated after as_of (T6) and a fault code (T8).
files_note: tanks.csv (tank master list, WAT-02) and meta.csv's timezone column (TIME-02) are the Phase-1 additions the lead's defaults call for; the current code ignores both. health.csv carries HLTH-03's proposed generator fix (Cows Fly tag check: done 2026-09-01, next_due blank) unless the scenario says otherwise.
computed_by: docs/audit/diagnostics/scenarios.build.py: Python arithmetic on this folder's CSV files. It never calls exceptions.js or app.js.
matching: alerts_exact: every needs-attention row the implementation shows must be one of expected_rows (or allowed_extra_rows); data-issue and CAN'T TELL rows may carry extra wording. A row matches on area, kind and subject_key; state (or a listed alternative) and severity must agree; every key number must be shown, correctly rounded to the precision shown; key_dates may be ISO or 'Mon D'; key_tags must all appear; must_not_appear strings must not.
